problem_statement: The mDNS module exposes an API to iterate the full list of local host IPv4 and IPv6 addresses that the platform reports to it (e.g. via otPlatMdnsHandleHostAddressEvent), for inspection/debugging. With this API present, an application can allocate an mDNS iterator and repeatedly request the next local host address entry until an 'end of list' status is returned, each entry reporting whether it is IPv6 or IPv4, the infrastructure interface index, and the address. Without the API, this information cannot be retrieved through the mDNS module.
